lastCompletedStory.title: Thread -L cam through cam next / cam plan / cam issue launchers

nextStoryContext: US-001 threaded -L cam through session.ts; US-002 through run.ts; US-003 through next.ts probe and confirmed plan.ts + issue.ts were already compliant. Next stories thread through remaining call sites. Pattern: wrap all direct tmux spawn calls with tmuxArgs([...]). Shell-evaluated strings (like kill-session chain in agentCmd) must use literal 'tmux -L cam' since tmuxArgs() only applies to direct spawn calls. Fake spawn handlers in tests route by args[2] (the subcommand) not args[0], because args[0]==='-L' and args[1]==='cam' now.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-001/002/003 all use same -L flag pattern; no new external lib introduced in US-003.
US-003 only changes a tmux probe argv literal in next.ts. No external library API surface changed.
